findings: Separate long petioles with three broad leaflets, upright white raceme above creeping wetland rhizome. Generic single terminal bloom rejected. Dedicated menyanthes staged. Current seeds 1, 4 and 7 and every panel in the 36-seed contact sheet were visually inspected. Trifoliate leaves on separate petioles accompany upright white racemes. The 20–40 cm forms vary colony spread and stalk height. Small raceme florets merge at the finest sizes; petal fringes are unresolved. Creeping basal connections should sit within wet soil. Accepted as a coarse stylized spring source at 25 mm; user endorsement remains separate.
